title: [Feature Request][BUG]: AgentRunner arun_step have to make dispatcher asynchronous as well
body:
### Feature Description

I think you should add an abstract `ahandle `method to the `BaseEventHandler` that will handle asynchronous calls to `dispatcher.aevent()` or something similar.
Because if I run an application in a prod for many people, I don't want to suffer from synchronous dispatching.

### Reason

There no existing approaches, cause I need to create a subclass from AgentRunner to fix it. 

### Value of Feature

It will speed up the process of step execution.
